regional_compliance.tax_context: Standard federal and state income tax; commercial fishing has some federal tax provisions related to vessel depreciation and capital construction funds.
regional_compliance.labor_regulation: Commercial fishing has unique federal labor classifications (often exempt from certain standard overtime rules under the Fair Labor Standards Act for specific vessel work).
regional_compliance.licensing_bodies: NOAA Fisheries / NMFS for federal quota and permit systems, US Coast Guard vessel documentation, state department of fish and wildlife for state water permits and landing requirements.
key_compliance_terms: NOAA Fisheries permit and quota system
US Coast Guard vessel safety inspection

humanity_mode_regional_addendum.0_percent: NOAA Fisheries federal quota allocation systems, FDA HACCP seafood safety compliance, US Coast Guard vessel documentation requirements.

learning_objectives: Understand how NOAA Fisheries quota allocation systems determine legal catch limits for US commercial operators.
Analyze the role of FDA HACCP requirements in seafood safety compliance from vessel to buyer.
